answer: No seat votes unless its key was generated inside a basalt chip that cannot export it, and the chip's attestation carries a glacier signature. The glacier ships chips only to verified delivery addresses and prices the n-th chip sent to one address at 40n prism. An honest newcomer pays 40 prism. An operator fielding 20 clones from one address pays 40+80+…+800, or 8,400 prism, and the 20th chip alone costs 800. Splitting orders means paying unrelated people to accept chips at their own addresses and hand them over.
